description: Decode an error, warning or note exeris-tooling printed — an annotation-processor message, a codegen plugin goal failure or warning, a capability-graph or cap-tier Wall refusal, a missing runtime driver, a code-generation pipeline or CodegenMain line, or an exeris-initializr error. Paste the diagnostic text verbatim; returns what it means, the rule behind it, and what to do. Looks each diagnostic up by its stable EXT- identifier (ADR-095), which exeris-tooling prints from 0.9.0, and falls back to message text only for output that carries none. An identifier with no catalogue entry is named back as a catalogue gap, and a diagnostic it does not recognise is reported as not in the catalogue — never as not being an Exeris problem.

text.description: The diagnostic, pasted verbatim. A whole build log is fine — every recognised diagnostic in it is returned.

name: build-explain_diagnostic
